_help.mission.search_start_wp: First AUTO mission item where the Pi is allowed to search for targets.
_help.mission.search_enabled: Set false for Mission 1/no-search profiles. Mission 2 must be true.
_help.mission.search_enable_rc_channel: Optional extra RC switch gate. Null disables the RC gate. Example: 7 means RC channel 7 must be high before search can start.
_help.navigation.search_speed_source: qgc_mission means Mission Planner/QGC/ArduPilot owns AUTO speed. companion_do_change_speed makes the Pi send MAV_CMD_DO_CHANGE_SPEED.
_help.control.center_max_speed_m_s: Maximum horizontal speed during GUIDED centering.
_help.control.center_tolerance_px: Default pixel error accepted as centered. Bigger is safer; smaller is more precise.
_help.control.center_tolerance_px_by_target: Optional target-specific tolerance. Red triangle can need a slightly larger tolerance because its visual center jitters more.
_help.control.target_lost_timeout_s: How long to stay still in GUIDED while trying to reacquire a confirmed target before it keeps searching in place.
_help.safety.max_guided_auto_bounces_per_targe: Diagnostic only; keep null so GUIDED lock has no time limit during active centering.
_help.safety.active_target_abort_mode: Fallback mode for explicit abort paths only. Normal target loss and slow centering now hold GUIDED and keep trying.
_help.vision.search_min_area_px: Lower this carefully if real targets are too small at higher altitude.
_help.vision.red_hsv_ranges / blue_hsv_range: Target color ranges in OpenCV HSV. Tune only from raw Pi-camera images under representative outdoor light.
_help.vision.search_max_area_fraction: Reject a search contour that fills an implausibly large part of the frame.
_help.vision.search_border_margin_px: Require the complete target to be visible before initial confirmation; active tracking may still follow it near an edge.
_help.camera.camera_index: Logical Picamera2 camera number, not the physical connector. With one detected camera, keep 0 even if the ribbon is on CAM/DISP 1.
_help.camera.lens_position: Manual focus calibration in inverse metres. 0.15 is a starting point near 6.7 m and must be calibrated at the actual flight height.
_help.camera.max_exposure_time_us: Maximum exposure retained after warm-up; lower values reduce flight motion blur but require more light/gain.
_help.payload.simulate_only: Keep true until servo and payload bench tests pass. Set false only for physical payload output.
_help.payload.servo_channel: Pixhawk output channel for payload. Use 5 when the payload servo signal wire is on MAIN OUT / signal 5.
_help.payload.blue_payload_pwm: Selector position used for the blue payload on a red triangle: 1300 PWM.
_help.payload.red_payload_pwm: Selector position used for the red payload on a blue hexagon: 1700 PWM.
_help.payload.neutral_pwm: Servo midpoint used after every release: 1500 PWM.
_help.payload.release_hold_s: Keep the selector at the target position for 3 seconds before returning to neutral.
_help.display.show_main_window: Keep false on Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Use real_mission/open_laptop_camera_window.sh on the Ubuntu laptop for live viewing.
_help.safety.camera_frame_timeout_s: If camera frames stop during active target work, hold position after this many seconds. Set null to disable.
_help.safety.manual_override_behavior: If the pilot/failsafe changes to a non-AUTO/non-GUIDED mode, the Pi stops commanding and waits for AUTO instead of fighting the pilot.
